routes.problem: Wrong binding, cross-module rename or broken imports
routes.first_probe: Resolve compiler declaration identity, aliases, actual references, reverse dependents and generated clients
routes.experiment: Two same-named independent symbols; rename only selected binding through imported aliases
routes.acceptance: Compiler has no newly introduced diagnostics; references and behavioral tests preserve unrelated symbol
routes.risk: Reflection and nonliteral dynamic imports require separate analysis

routes.problem: An action is reported successful without real side effect or receipt
routes.first_probe: Trace request accepted, handler invoked, durable effect, committed receipt and provider readback as separate states
routes.experiment: Crash at every transition and use missing-handler and missing-receipt negative cases
routes.acceptance: SUCCEEDED implies a genuine observed effect and corresponding persistent receipt; invalid paths fail closed
routes.risk: Local fixture harness ablation is not end-to-end agent evaluation

routes.problem: Concurrent or retried requests duplicate a domain effect
routes.first_probe: Find linearization point, durable idempotency identity, atomic commit and lost-acknowledgement window
routes.experiment: Parallel duplicates, conflicting same-key request, restart before and after commit, lost ack
routes.acceptance: One domain effect per canonical key under explicit storage assumptions, with conflict and uncertain claims rejected
routes.risk: In-process locks and HTTP success cannot prove multi-process exactly-once

routes.problem: Untrusted input, privilege or tenant crossing reaches an unauthorized effect
routes.first_probe: Identify actor, target, authorization boundary, taint sources/sinks and policy enforcement
routes.experiment: Wrong-account object ID, stale token, replay and source-to-sink path with adversarial payloads
routes.acceptance: Unauthorized requests are denied at service and data boundaries without a side effect
routes.risk: Static taint model omissions and dynamic calls need live negative tests

routes.problem: Code or feature flag appears unused and might be removed
routes.first_probe: Review history, runtime configuration, feature overrides, dynamic consumers and emergency kill switches
routes.experiment: Probe production-equivalent flag and dynamic paths before and after proposed deletion
routes.acceptance: No observed regression across active routes, configurations or rollback path
routes.risk: Static zero references alone never establishes dead code

routes.problem: Parser misclassification or transformation changes semantics
routes.first_probe: Define valid input/output variants, metamorphic invariants, independent oracle and exact failure seed
routes.experiment: Generate malformed and equivalent inputs, shrink counterexamples and compare against independent implementation
routes.acceptance: Known bad inputs fail correctly; equivalent representations preserve intended behavior; compiler checks pass
routes.risk: Passing tests do not imply full semantic equivalence

routes.problem: Claimed coding capability increase lacks independent evidence
routes.first_probe: Freeze real task and starting SHA, seal grader, audit rubric validity and execution traces
routes.experiment: Blindly reapply generated patches to clean held-out repositories with independent acceptance and regression tests
routes.acceptance: Verified functional task success improves under matched tools, budgets and task cohorts with no false positives
routes.risk: Current eval:harness only measures local durable-journal behavior, not LLM coding competence
